bfsi.headline: AI and software for India's most regulated industry.
bfsi.intro: From RBI-supervised banks to IRDAI-regulated insurers, BFSI customers expect engineering rigor and regulatory traceability in equal measure. We bring both.
useCases: Insurance policy admin and claims systems
Agency CRMs and partner enablement portals
regulatoryNotes: SOC 2 Type II readiness for SaaS sub-vendors
techExamples: Microservices on AWS / Azure with VPC isolation

healthcare.headline: Clinical-grade software, engineered for patient data.
healthcare.intro: Healthcare workflows are unforgiving — uptime, audit trails, and data integrity are not optional. We build systems that hold up under HIPAA, NDHM, and clinical scrutiny.
techExamples: Encryption at rest + in transit (FIPS-validated where required)

enterprise-saas.headline: The team behind your roadmap when you need to ship.
enterprise-saas.intro: Whether you're standing up an MVP, scaling a multi-tenant platform, or layering AI on existing workflows — we plug in as a delivery team that ships on your timeline.
useCases: Migration off legacy and tech-debt remediation
